newsitem.title: USA: Calif. commission okays PG&E reorganization.
newsitem.headline: Calif. commission okays PG&E reorganization.

text.p: The California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) said Wednesday it conditionally approved Pacific Gas and Electric Co's plan to reorganize and become the subsidiary of a holding company.

The state's two other investor-owned utilities, Southern California Edison Co, and San Diego Gas and Electric Co, are already subsidiaries of holding companies Edison International and Enova Corp, respectively.
PG&E has 45 days to agree to the conditions, which include an audit and examination of utility/affiliate transactions from 1994 to the present, the commission said.
